exposure: Implementation of post-CS SSI prevention protocol
Prolonged rupture of membranes (ROM) before ERCS
outcome: Incidence of post-CS surgical site infection (SSI)
cohort: The study included 229 women who delivered by elective repeat cesarean section (ERCS) at Ahmadi Hospital, Kuwait, split into two groups: those delivering after protocol implementation and those before.
finding: The incidence of post-CS SSI significantly reduced following the implementation of the post-CS SSI prevention protocol, and obesity, pregestational diabetes, prolonged ROM, ERCS duration over 1 hour, and surgical difficulties/adhesions were identified as significant risk factors for post-CS SSI.
